name: kakuki-worker
description: Kakuki blog backend on Cloudflare Workers + D1 (isolated rewrite of the Django backend)

scripts.db:seed:local: node seed/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute kakuki-db --local --file seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node seed/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute kakuki-db --remote --file seed/seed.sql
